definitions.explanation: The act of stopping smoking completely. A more emphatic and decisive term than 禁煙, emphasizing the finality of cutting off the habit.

examples.japanese: {断煙|だんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
{断煙|だんえん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧からもう⟦{三|さん}{年|ねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: It's been three years since I quit smoking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{断煙|だんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{勧|すす}められた→勧める：02120_susumeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦なかなか→なかなか：01547_nakanaka⟧⟦{実行|じっこう}できない→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧。
examples.english: I was advised to quit smoking for my health, but I can't seem to follow through.

notes:
{断|だん} means 'to cut off' or 'to sever,' and {煙|えん} means 'smoke.' {断煙|だんえん} emphasizes the decisive, complete severing of the smoking habit, making it a stronger expression than ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断煙|だんえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to quit smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}する→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧ (to resolve to quit smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧ (to succeed in quitting smoking)
- {断煙|だんえん}⟦{補助|ほじょ}→補助：14105_hojo⟧ (smoking cessation aid)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧ — no smoking; smoking cessation (the most common word; also used for 'no-smoking' areas)
- {卒煙|そつえん} — graduating from smoking (a more positive, casual way to say one has quit)
- ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ — smoking (the opposite; the act of smoking)
